SANAM PREET KAUR

PH-7, Fortuna Icon Apartment, Block- F, Sahakar Nagar | Bangalore, Karnataka | 560092 | +91- 9914488570| aangelvirgo@gmail.com

An innovative and dedicated professional, aiming to put my abilities and learning skills to best use and make my effective contribution to an organization for a bright and rewarding career.

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Routing - OSPF, BGP. • Switching - VLAN, STP, EtherChannel, VRRP, ACL, DHCP, Dot1x, Inter VLAN Routing, MC- LAG, TCP/IP, HTTPS/HTTP, ARP, DNS.

Tools and Technology: Juniper Routing Switching, JUNOS, MIST, Wireshark.

WORK EXPERIENCE:

Current Company: Juniper Networks [06th June 2022– Present (3 Years, 5 months)] Role: Technical Support Engineer 2 - Switching

Job Responsibilities:

Providing high level technical support, including identifying and resolving problems on juniper routing & switching products.

Analyzing customer’s Configuration on Juniper switches. • Replicating/Reproducing customer’s network issues in lab to provide solution based on the research/analysis on the lab work.

Taking secure meeting sessions to support customer in troubleshooting network issues.

Analyzing logs messages to provide RCA [Root Cause Analysis] for the issues noticed in customer environment.

Demonstrate ownership of customer reported issues till resolution. • Understand Customer’s impact, prioritize and communicate effectively between various stakeholders.

Providing support for Juniper’s Campus & Data-Center products (EX, QFX) &



technologies. Implemented and managed Juniper Mist Wired Assurance, providing cloud-driven automation, monitoring and troubleshooting for campus networks.

Onboarding and configures Juniper EX/QFX switches in the Mist cloud Portal. • I am actively involved in both authoring technical knowledge documents and supporting the team by reviewing their technical content.

Worked as a Network Engineer with Vodafone Global Services Private Limited [30th November 2018 to 31st July 2019 (8 Months)]

Job Responsibilities of Monitoring:

• Supervise the monitoring tools real time. • Monitor networks of more than 500+ customers within defined SLA.

Notify the customer and internal stakeholders of the faults and the impact to the network.

Provide initial diagnosis of faults by validating alarms and creating trouble tickets for investigation by other teams.

Worked as An Assistant Manager [01st August 2019 to 07th Jan 2022 (2 years, 5 months)]

Job Responsibilities of 1st Line:

Working within a Network Operations Centre (NOC) environment doing troubleshooting and diagnostics for WAN, LAN and Wireless LAN.

Troubleshooting on issues like Packet drops, Latency, Link Flapping, IP reachability, IP Routing.

Providing remote support for onsite engineers for installing new routers and switches. • Interacting with different last mile teams to get the Major, Information dockets resolved in specified time duration (ETA).

Arranging the Field Engineer to the customer site and follow up the same to investigate any physical discrepancies in a router, checking configuration issues or replacement of faulty router and switches.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Cisco Certified Network Associate Routing and Switching (200-120) • CCNP Routing and Switching (300-101, 300-115, 300-135) • Implementing Cisco Network Security (210-260) • JNCIA-Junos, JNCIS-ENT, JNCIA-MIST, JNCIP-ENT • B.Tech - ECE from C.E.C, Landran, PTU University • M.Tech- ECE from C.G.C College of Engineering, Landran, PTU University

PERSONAL DETAILS:

Date of birth • Gender • Languages Known

: 22/09/1990 : Female : English, Hindi and Punjabi

DECLARATION:

I declare that the above information is true and correct to the best of my knowledge and nothing has been concealed or distorted.

Sanam Preet Kaur
